name: Scotch Creek Ventures Inc.
summary: Scotch Creek Ventures Inc. focuses on the procurement, exploration, and advancement of mineral resources across the United States. The company fully owns the Cupz property, a significant asset comprising 39 unpatented lode mining claims and covering approximately 806 acres in Esmeralda County, Nevada. Furthermore, it holds stakes in two other Nevada-based ventures: the Highlands West project, which encompasses 5,960 acres situated on the southwest flank of Clayton Valley, and the Macallan East project, spanning 3,180 acres on the southeast side of southern Clayton Valley. Scotch Creek Ventures Inc. was established in 2017 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
